description: Requires an approved AlertForge account connection. OAuth-aware clients should start AlertForge's secure authorization flow and ask the user only to sign in and approve. Setup: https://alertforge.ai/ai-agents#agent-setup. Free to call. Read-only -- unlike get_pack_status, this does NOT advance anything (the render worker progresses these on its own schedule, outside this call). Reports each alert's current status (queued/running/succeeded/failed), its result WebM URL once done, its OBS overlay URL, and its credit cost. Poll at a reasonable interval until every alert reaches a terminal state; provider timing varies.
name: get_alert_pack_status
title: Check AI Alert pack status
